author: blu
body: A listener has no peer. Zero is the sentinel the demux already keys on for an unclaimed listener, and `tcp-step-listening` learns the real port from the SYN, so clearing it here is what makes that sentinel true rather than merely usually true. `remote-ip` is deliberately left alone: `tcp-step-listening` carries it forward too, and `net-process-ip` overwrites it from the IP header when the connection reaches SYN_RECEIVED.

author: blu
body: Pinned by `codex/test/tcp-listen-reclaim.codex`, whose second control is the load-bearing one -- deleting the remote-port check would also admit the second caller, so the test demands that a claimed listener still refuse a stranger.
